ios.desc:
iDitty brings the modern music experience back into the real world. The CD industry is fading away, but fans still want to be able to buy physical copies of a musician's album. The app brings all your content from iDitty to your mobile device. Access existing cards on your account, scan new cards or create playlists for any mood. 

Musicians on the iDitty platform have loaded our cards with music, videos, artwork and so much more. When you redeem a card, you get instant access to all that fantastic content direct from your browser or mobile device! That's not all. Each and every iDitty card grants you exclusive access to your favorite artists' exclusive content through our innovative Perks system, and gives you the opportunity to connect in a way that no music platform has ever offered before. An iDitty card is an ongoing experience, allowing artists and fans to connect over their shared passion for music.

How to Buy iDitty Cards
Physical Cards: Pick up an iDitty card from a fan club or the merch tent at your favorite concert or event and access premium content and an enhanced experience right that very second. No downloads required, just scan the back of the card to instantly access premium content. Many iDitty cards are collectibles themselves, can be signed at events (or order limited-edition signed cards), framed and hung on the wall, and generally used to "show off" at any gathering.

Virtual Cards: Add as many virtual cards to your iDitty private cloud collection as you want. Get all the benefits of the physical card and save even more! Cards can include songs, whole albums, exclusive videos and pictures, VIP experiences, and lots more. Check out the website or Explore new cards on the app.
